name: backend
description: Rush Code backend API (NestJS 12 + TypeScript 6 + Zod 4 + Drizzle)

scripts.test:e2e:opencode-keys: bun run build && bun dist/opencode-keys/crypto.service.spec.js && bun dist/opencode-keys/opencode-keys.e2e.js
